tools.name: keep_awake_status
tools.title: Keep Awake's state
tools.description: Whether Keep Awake is on (no screensaver, lock, screen-off or sleep, closing the lid included): on, until (Unix time it turns off by itself, 0 = until turned off) and minutes (the time chosen).

tools.name: keep_awake_set
tools.title: Keep the computer awake
tools.description: Turns Keep Awake on (no screensaver, lock, screen-off or sleep, closing the lid included) for minutes, or until turned off without them, or turns it off: back to the usual idle times. On again replaces the earlier time. Logging out turns it off.

minutes.title: Minutes
minutes.description: With on: how long. Leave it out for until turned off
